[[File:Star_Tours_Bothan_Space.jpg|thumb|Star Tours bulletin requiring the use of an Imperial authorization form to access Bothan Space.]]
An '''Imperial authorization form''' was a type of code used to clear individuals to access certain areas of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when making outbound flights from certain [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]], such as [[Spaceport THX1138]].

Between [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]]-owned Spaceport THX1138, requested that any passengers headed to the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]] used their Imperial authorization forms before boarding.

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial authorization form was mentioned briefly in the queue area of the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', covering explanations on Spaceport THX1138's areas.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' {{C|Tokyo only}}
